component.name: Accented
component.summary: Choose an exact accent for supported GTK applications

description.p: Pick a screen pixel or enter a color, then apply it to GTK user styles. Existing CSS is preserved, with guarded backups and restore.

This sandboxed edition writes only GTK 3 and GTK 4 configuration directories and Accented recovery state. Matching the native GNOME Shell preset is unavailable in this edition. Qt, Electron and other sandboxes may not follow GTK user styles.
